## Bank
- Arm: paste N, get X. Exactness or refuse. v1 from Python.
- UI: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank
- API: POST https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/api/bank  {source, from:"py", to:"js"}
- CLI: cuni bank paste IN --from py --to js
- Law: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni/blob/master/docs/BANK.md
- Tag: cuni-bank-0.1.0
- Not 119 ingest parsers. 119 langs remains cuni check on the deposit.
